violations.text: Several dead rodents were observed on glue boards/on the floor in the side storage area. Dead pests must be removed from the establishment. New Violation. Correct By: 09/01/2026

The presence of rodents is not controlled as evidenced by live activity (Live mouse on glue trap) and an accumulation of rodent droppings.. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. Establishment is currently receiving pest control monthly. PCS frequency to increase to at least twice a month until pest activity decreases. New Violation. Correct By: 09/01/2026

The floors behind equipment/pallets in the facility have an accumulation of rodent droppings. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 09/01/2026

The wall in the storage area is in poor repair. Wall was observed with some gaps in foam. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. Per PIC work order has already been placed. New Violation. Correct By: 05/19/2025

The floor next to the wall in the storage area has an small accumulation of old rodent droppings. The floors in the retail area under shelving was observed with a small accumulation of food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 05/05/2025
